description: We’re tackling “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” preserving the stories of equipment left behind in space. I’m seeking curious, creative teammates skilled in programming, web development, astronomy, graphic design, data visualization, animation, or storytelling. Beginners are welcome! Let’s explore and discover together. 🚀
summary:
Our project, Abandoned but not Forgotten : storytelling about NASAs' Equipment on space developed by Team Astro-chronicles, is an interactive educational website that explores NASA's forgotten space hardware across the Moon, Mars, and deep space. It tells the stories of important space equipment, including the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, explaining its purpose, technology, discoveries, current condition, and scientific importance.

The website features mission profiles, an interactive map, a timeline, discovery stories, and educational quizzes to make space exploration interesting and easy to understand. It addresses the challenge by highlighting NASA technologies that continue to contribute to science, even after their original missions have ended.

This project is important because it preserves the history of space exploration, raises awareness of NASA's scientific achievements, and inspires students and future generations to explore space and learn about the technology beyond Earth.
details:
Abandoned but not Forgotten By Astro-chronicles

Our project is an educational website that explores the history of human inventions and spacecraft that once seemed like science fiction. It presents scientific information in a simple, engaging, and accessible way through a user-friendly interface.

Its key feature, Astro-Bot, is an interactive mascot that guides users and answers their questions. We developed the website using :

  • HTML, CSS & JavaScript: Used to build the website and interactive features, including the Mars mission map and rover search simulation.
  • Canva : for website design and development.
  • Netlify: Used to host the interactive web pages.
  • Google Forms: Used to create the interactive quiz.
  • Sketch-fab: Used to integrate a 3D rover model.
  • NASA: Used as a source of space mission information and scientific data

The project's creativity lies in combining education with interactive technology. We focused on simplicity, accessibility, and user experience. Our goal is to inspire young people and space enthusiasts to explore forgotten inventions and spacecraft while making scientific knowledge accessible to everyone.
